task_completion.description: The agent selects NGC 7000 (North America Nebula) as the imaging target.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The target name 'NGC 7000' or coordinates (RA 20:58:47, Dec +44:19:48) are entered into the telescope control or sequencing software.

task_completion.description: The agent configures the sequence to use Ha, OIII, and SII filters.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The sequence table or filter wheel settings show 'Ha', 'OIII', and 'SII' (or slots 5, 6, and 4 respectively) as active for the session.

task_completion.description: The agent executes the capture sequence for all three narrowband filters.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Progress bars, status logs, or a file explorer showing at least 5 FITS files being generated for each filter (Ha, OIII, SII).

task_completion.description: The agent processes the captured frames into a SHO (Hubble Palette) composite image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An image processing window (e.g., Siril, PixInsight, or similar) showing the mapping of SII to Red, Ha to Green, and OIII to Blue.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the final composite image as specified in the imaging plan.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or 'Save As' dialog showing the final composite image file saved in the designated output directory.

integrity.description: The agent used the astronomical software GUI rather than just terminal commands to simulate image creation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, menu selections, and active windows of imaging software (e.g., KStars/Ekos, NINA, or Siril).

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename existing files to match the required filter names.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence logs or camera status window show active exposure countdowns and hardware communication (INDI/ASCOM).

integrity.description: The agent did not manually edit the imaging_plan.txt to change requirements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The content of ~/Documents/imaging_plan.txt remains consistent with the initial task parameters when viewed in a text editor.

privileged_info_for_vlm: Target: NGC 7000 (North America Nebula) at RA 20.979, Dec 44.334. Required filters and slots: Ha (Slot 5), OIII (Slot 6), SII (Slot 4). Minimum of 5 FITS files per filter are required. The final image must be an SHO composite (SII=Red, Ha=Green, OIII=Blue).
